description: The plot illustrates the results of "Whisper fine-tunning, type = tiny," comparing the performance of five different model configurations across a series of epochs. The x-axis is labeled "epoch" and features a linear scale ranging from 0 to 6, with numeric tick marks spaced at intervals of 1. The y-axis is labeled "WER" and uses a linear scale ranging from 30 to 70, with tick marks at intervals of 10. The "tiny AdaLoRA_int4" configuration is represented by a solid grey line with circle markers; it begins at an epoch of 0 with a WER of approximately 70, declines to roughly 52 at epoch 4, and then rises to end at approximately 57 at epoch 6. The "tiny AdaLoRA_int8" configuration is shown as a solid grey line with square markers, starting at a WER of about 61 at epoch 0, dropping to 55 at epoch 1, rising to 57 at epoch 2, declining to its lowest point of roughly 49 at epoch 4, and ending near 49 at epoch 6. The "tiny int4" configuration is depicted by a dashed grey line with circle markers, starting at approximately 70 at epoch 0, steadily declining to about 51 at epoch 4, and then rising to end at roughly 54 at epoch 6. The "tiny int8" configuration is represented by a dashed grey line with square markers, beginning at about 61 at epoch 0, dropping sharply to 50 at epoch 1, rising slightly to 52 at epoch 2, remaining steady until epoch 3, and ending at approximately 54 at epoch 6. Finally, the "tiny full" configuration is shown as a dotted grey line with upward-pointing triangle markers; it starts at the lowest WER of approximately 30 at epoch 0 and exhibits a steady upward trend, ending at roughly 40 at epoch 6.
